items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Pat is addressed directly by the interviewee ('As a matter of fact, Pat...', 'Pat, I am going to do some recording...') indicating Pat is the interviewer, not a subject of the interviewee's professional or personal history in the context of the relationship being judged.

ctx.x: Just me accompanying him, and he would just sit by me and I'd have -- get this stool and just the two of us on stage, it was just -- I enjoyed it very much. As a matter of fact, Pat, I was with him, when he had this little alleged fight at Caesar's Palace. At the Sands?
